paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : LLaMA-2-7B
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the informativeness of different extensions to a math word problem. The x-axis is linear, displaying values ranging from 0 to 4 with tick intervals of 1, and labeled ‘Extension Length (s)’. The y-axis represents “Informativeness,” with values ranging from 0.920 to 0.970, also on a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.010. A dashed blue line with markers displays a value of approximately 0.920 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 0.918 at x=4. A solid orange line with markers begins at a value of approximately 0.960 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 0.958 at x=4. A solid yellow line with markers starts at a value of approximately 0.950 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 0.948 at x=4.
